card.name: Spaces and joints before numbers in instructions
card.fires_on: Mostly the position just before a number or the middle of a word in device and infusion instructions, such as the space after Figure or Rb, or the gap before 0.9% Sodium Chloride. It also fires on small joining words like the, up and a comma in dosing and preparation steps.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space after Figure or an isotope symbol, right before the number.

modes.label: Linking words in preparation steps
modes.description: Short words or punctuation inside instructions for syringes, pumps and infusion lines.

card.writes: It slightly favors delivery, generation and injection words and disfavors capture and collection words.
card.plain: It fires on small gaps and joining words in step-by-step device and infusion instructions, often just before a number.
